name: Maurits Fokkens
about_text:
Hello! I'm Maurits, a software developer focused on DevOps and mobile development. I have been programming since I was 15 and have built experience through personal projects, education, internships, and professional roles.

I enjoy combining software development with infrastructure, exploring new technologies, and building practical solutions that help people in their daily lives. Collaboration, supporting others, and continually expanding my technical skills are central to how I work.
